title: Variance from positive bias
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $p$ be the uniform probability that $f$ takes the value $+1$. Then $\operatorname{Var}(f)=4p(1-p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
